title: Relative de Rham Poincare duality as a perfect pairing of perfect complexes

standard_prerequisites.name: Derived categories, perfect complexes and duality, relative Hodge-to-de Rham spectral sequences, relative coherent cohomological dimension and Serre duality. The local relative Hodge and boundary-degeneration arguments are retained.
standard_prerequisites.use: These are the named standard inputs; the selected main construction and its local nonroutine support remain in full.

core_obligations: Identify the top de Rham trace using the relative Hodge boundary degeneration and relative Serre pairing.
Construct the compatible filtered wedge pairings and use the derived comparison triangles to prove perfectness.

proof_roadmap.step: Identify the top de Rham trace using the relative Hodge boundary degeneration and relative Serre pairing.
Construct the compatible filtered wedge pairings and use the derived comparison triangles to prove perfectness.

difficulty_reason: 本题的实质要求是证明相对 Poincaré 对偶：对拟紧拟分离 S 上纤维非空且等维 n 的 proper smooth 态射 f : X → S，构造 t : R^{2n}f_*Ω^•_{X/S} → O_S，使 Rf_*Ω^• ⊗^L Rf_*Ω^•[2n] → O_S 成为完美对偶（t 在乘以 H^0(X,O_X) 单位的意义下唯一）。在允许引用相对 Hodge--de Rham 谱序列、维数上界导致的消失与两条退化引理之后，仍须完成：①用谱序列与消失/退化把 R^0f_*Ω_{X/S}、R^nf_*Ω^n_{X/S} 分别与 R^0f_*O_X、R^{2n}f_*Ω^• 同一化，并把 t 归到 Lemma relative-duality-hodge 的情形；②考察楔积 ∧ : Tot(Ω^• ⊗ Ω^•) → Ω^•，对每个 p = 0,…,n 说明它零化 Tot(σ_{>p}Ω^• ⊗ σ_{≥n−p}Ω^•)（次数原因），从而把 ∧ 限制到愚蠢截断上得到 γ_p，再按 cup product 一节的方法得到相对 cup product 并证明配对完美。该部分见 derham.tex（行号见 locator 字段）。与通常资格考试训练相比，增加的要求是：自行用谱序列退化与截断过滤拼装出对偶配对的完美性。

compared.difference: Single migration of this unpublished research record.
Garel maps and Tate determinant dualizing isomorphisms concern quasi-finite syntomic maps. This is a proper smooth relative de Rham perfect pairing in degree 2n.
